d:
Dilli men sthit jamiya milliya islamiya yunivarsiti men bite kaee dinon se student protest kar rahe hain. in chhatron ki mang hai ki yunivarsiti men student yuniyan ke chunav karvae jaen aur yuniyan ko bahal kiya jae. sal 2006 ke bad se abhi tak is yunivarsiti men student yuniyan ke chunav nahin hue hain. is bich yunivarsiti prashasan ne students se batchit bhi ki lekin phir bhi yah virodh pradarshan samapt nahin huaa hai. dekhie yah graund riport.
Vidiyoh shubh rana aur mohammad mehroz
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
